purpose: Acquire independent-source observations overlapping already-adjudicated place/time/construct cells for measurement-error identification, without using model outcomes or latent values.

admission_rules: A candidate must be independently coded blind to the existing adjudicated row.
The independently coded observation must overlap the frozen district/time cell and recover the same construct family without being prompted with the expected answer.
Source genealogy must support a genuinely independent originating information pipeline before the candidate counts as replication.
A secondary aggregator does not count as an independent source if it merely republishes the same originating report.
Candidate disagreement is retained; no source is discarded because it fails to corroborate the existing evidence.
scientific_use: Measurement-error identification only; no Nepal predictive rescore, parameter tuning, or core modification.
